title: HackNova 2026: 36-Hour National Hackathon
tagline: Build the autonomous future with AI & Cloud
description: Join 500+ student developers across the nation to construct disruptive AI, web3, and cloud prototypes. Mentorship from top industry engineers, hardware lab access, and direct internship opportunities.
organizer: Department of Computer Science & ACM Student Chapter

title: Rhythm & Echoes: Annual Cultural Gala
tagline: A starry evening of music, theater, and fusion dance
description: The flagship cultural extravaganza of the semester featuring inter-college battle of the bands, classical fusion performances, theatrical street plays, and celebrity headliner musical concerts.

title: Valorant & BGMI Campus Showdown
tagline: Compete on LAN for the university e-sports trophy
description: 5v5 tactical shooter and mobile battle royale tournament broadcast live on campus displays. Professional caster commentary, low-latency gigabit network arena, and custom trophies.

title: Autonomous Drone & Robotics Bootcamp
tagline: Hands-on flight control, computer vision, and ROS2
description: An intensive full-day masterclass guiding participants through drone assembly, sensor calibration, optical flow stabilization, and autonomous navigation using OpenCV and ROS2.

title: Apex Venture: Campus Startup Pitch Fest
tagline: Pitch your venture to angel investors and seed VCs
description: Student entrepreneurs present their MVPs and business plans to a jury of active angel investors and startup alumni. Winning teams secure initial grant funding, incubation space, and legal guidance.

title: Inter-Collegiate Futsal Derby
description: 16 university teams clash in an intense knockout tournament on the campus turf. Fast-paced 20-minute halves, referee association certified officiating, and roaring crowd atmospheres.
